results.title: Dinesh Chauhan elected Bar Assn president in Jagadhri
results.description: Advocate Dinesh Chauhan has been elected president of the District Bar Association, Jagadhri, defeating his nearest rival Pardeep Rathore by a margin of 558 votes. Chauhan secured 1,100 votes, while Rathore polled 542 votes. A total of 1,651 votes were cast out of 1,763 registered votes. The election witnessed keen contests for all six posts, [...]
